target_platform: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; WSL2 Linux and Linux containers

D-005-input-surrogate-rejection.scope: HTTP request bodies containing lone (unpaired) UTF-16 surrogate code units are rejected with HTTP 400 and JSON-RPC -32700 carrying an explicit parse message. stdio lines with lone surrogates are treated like any other unparseable line (silent skip per the framing contract). Valid surrogate pairs and all other normal Unicode text remain accepted and must keep matching the oracle (differential case stage.list.chapter-astral-pair).

D-006-unparseable-body-json-error.scope: HTTP request bodies that fail JSON parsing return HTTP 400 with a JSON-RPC -32700 parse error instead of the Express HTML error page the oracle emits. Applies to the parse failure itself only; no other error shape, status code, or body family changes.

D-007-native-regex-unicode-folding.scope: Retain the existing Rust Unicode simple case folding behavior for the identified categories: ASCII character ranges and Unicode property escapes (including inverted properties), instead of adding Bun-specific exceptions. This approval does not waive unrelated regex differences.

rust_implementation_status: P0-P8 complete (24 tools); P9 native performance complete; approved differences D-001 through D-007
